text: The Fed just hiked rates to 3.75%-4% while payrolls collapsed to just 29,000 jobs and inflation jumped to 3.7% — this stagflationary combination of rising rates, weakening employment, and sticky inflation creates a hostile environment for risk assets, especially speculative and unprofitable names in your portfolio.

RGTI is down 59%, revenue is shrinking by 34%, earnings are deeply negative, and it's nearly destroyed from its highs — there's no fundamental or technical reason to stay in this name, sell and preserve what's left.

QBTS is down 58% with no earnings, 73% off its high, 21% short interest, and catastrophic technicals — this is a broken position in a rising-rate environment that punishes unprofitable companies, so exit now.

IONQ is down 37%, 60% off its high, has negative earnings and high short interest — another speculative quantum computing name with no path to profitability in a tightening cycle, sell to stop the bleeding.
BMNR is down 13% and nearly 59% off its high with bearish technicals across every indicator — reduce your position size to limit further damage since the REDUCE signal confirms deterioration.

Adobe trades at a PE of just 8.7 with 10.5% revenue growth, outstanding free cash flow, and is 33% off its high — this is a profitable, cash-rich business on sale, and the ADD signal supports building your position on this pullback.
